title: Garden Snail Ka Khaufnaak Sach! 🐌 #shorts
idea: Uncovering surprising survival skills, mating rituals, and top speed of the Garden Snail (Cornu aspersum).

lines.text: Garden Snail mating ke time apne partner ko ek teer jaisa kanta ghusata hai!
Iss calcium ke kaante ko love dart kehte hain jo sperm ko bachata hai.
Aur ye snail donated sperm ko poore 4 saal tak zinda rakhta hai!
Thand mein ye blood badal kar minus 5 degree tak zinda rehta hai!
Competitions mein iss snail ki speed sirf 2.4 mm per second hoti hai!
Kya aapne kabhi apne garden mein Garden Snail dekha hai? Comment karo!

youtube.title: Garden Snail Ka Khaufnaak Sach! 🐌 #shorts
youtube.description:
Did you know Garden Snails use calcium love darts and can store sperm for 4 years? Discover amazing facts about Cornu aspersum!

#gardensnail #mindblowingfacts #hinglishfacts #naturefacts #shorts

facts.claim: Donated sperm can remain viable inside the snail for 4 years.
The snail can survive temperatures down to −5 °C by altering its blood components.
In competitions between snails, speeds of only 2.4 mm/s have been achieved.
